trafficSignalId.description: Human readable identifier for the Traffic Signal.
trafficSignalId.title: ObjectId

controlMethodId.description: Optional reference into the TrafficSignalType catalogue identifying the operational control method (MOVA, SCOOT, fixed-time, ...). Orthogonal to TrafficSignalConfiguration.trafficSignalType, which classifies the junction kind (intersection, pelican, puffin, ...).
controlMethodId.title: TypeId

creationDate.description: When this definition record was created.

shortDescription.description: Short human-readable name (e.g. 'Main St / High St junction').

participantId.description: System that owns this traffic signal definition. Often implicit from context.
participantId.title: ParticipantId

originatingParticipantId.description: Identifier of the upstream system that originally created this object (comparable to the UML DataSourceTypeId).
originatingParticipantId.title: ParticipantId

originatingObjectId.description: Identifier of this object on the originating (upstream) system. Enables cross-system traceability.
originatingObjectId.title: ObjectId

extensions.description: Vendor or forward-compatibility extensions. Open-content object.
